option_A_summary: Add `verified_decision` as new enum value in MCP signal_type schema (agentSignalTools.ts Zod enum + post_agent_signal.md tool doc + mcp-tools.md Inter-Agent Signal Types table)
rationale: Semantic clarity > schema minimalism. (1) `suppress` already has a precise meaning in mcp-tools.md L137: 'Alert Commander → All — False positive'. `verified_decision` has a different purpose: chain de-dup ack after alert-commander fires OR suppresses an alert. Conflating these under one enum value (Option B) would force receivers to disambiguate via payload inspection — semantic overload. (2) Schema cost: enum grows 8 → 9 values (≤13% growth). Not bloat. (3) Receiver readiness: scan of .claude/flows/news-scout/ and .claude/flows/market-watcher/ shows NO current `suppress` consumer logic — `suppress` is used only as a local dedup verb inside these flows, not as a typed cross-agent signal they react to. Option B would therefore require BOTH agent-father (to remove `verified_decision` from alert-commander.md) AND new receiver code in news-scout + market-watcher to handle a typed `suppress` signal_type. Net work for B exceeds A. (4) Existing alert-commander.md line 21 capability text already documents both signals as distinct ('Emit suppress AND verified_decision'). Option A keeps that contract; Option B requires rewriting it. (5) ITEM-02 brief recommendation favoured B on 'smaller enum surface' alone; PO override on the broader semantic + receiver-readiness argument.
